svg.title: PyBLE firmware 0.6.0 PBLE/1 functional block diagram
svg.desc: A functional architecture diagram, not a board drawing or pinout. The PyBLE app communicates over Bluetooth Low Energy through the PBLE/1 transport and protocol engine to identity, filesystem, runner, console, boot, and lifecycle modules in a compatible MicroPython device. A lower strip lists the five exact HIL-passed release profiles and their constraints.
svg.text: One embedded PBLE/1 control plane · five exact HIL-passed profiles
Functional architecture — not a board drawing, board detector, schematic, or pinout.
COMPATIBLE MICROPYTHON + BLE DEVICE · QUALIFIED PYBLE IMAGE
Optional GPIO Identify · ESP profiles only
Bad user code cannot block advertising
ESP Just Works pairing/bonding is not access-gating
Identity and label never authorize operations
Advertised label is public · avoid personal data
PyBLE agent sends no telemetry and needs no cloud service
VER 1 · CMD / RSP / EVT · request IDs · CRC32 frames · opcode dispatch · OK + 11 error statuses
LIST · STAT · offset GET + whole-file CRC
DELETE file / empty dir · MKDIR · RENAME
One program · idle / running / done / error
BLE remains responsive while user code runs
Bounded queues, buffers, retry and congestion work
Stale responses, events and work are discarded
CRC, resume, atomic commit and recovery evidence
Pico filesystem transfer during RUN → EBUSY
Upstream MicroPython v1.28.0 · normal user runtime
FAT on ESP · LFS2 on Pico · has_sd=0
PBLE jail does not restrict user os/VFS APIs
machine · os · VFS · asyncio on every profile
Explicit pins, buses and hardware-safe user code
machine APIs available on the selected port/board
Explicit pins and buses through user code only
No agent GPIO routing, pin map or detection
Waveshare exact image: ST7789 + boot splash
No display opcode · generic S3 omits display code
EXACT RELEASE PROFILES · TEXT CONSTRAINTS, NOT PHYSICAL BOARD APPEARANCE
Shared: PBLE/1 · MicroPython v1.28.0 · capabilities · files · safe Run/Stop · console · exact-byte HIL passed
ESP profiles · native C agent · NimBLE · W=8 · FAT · ESP Web Serial · upstream NeoPixel
Verified UF2 download + manual BOOTSEL copy
Named LED usable from user code
Identify and NeoPixel are not claimed in v0.6.0
Filesystem transfer during active RUN → EBUSY
Profiles describe compatible image constraints, not carrier-board appearance or pin maps. Matching N16R8 memory does not identify a display board.
Only the explicitly selected Waveshare B-version image includes ST7789/splash. Installation is destructive; everyday use after setup is BLE-first.
